name: Samophlange
summary: At the Venture Company console, you uncover the elusive samophlange and carry it to Ratchet. You have shut down the controls and their defenses; now the delicate device is ready for Sputtervalve to examine.

sections.title: Unearthing the Core
sections.body: Behind the Venture Company console's faceplate, wiring and purposeless tubing crowd around strange engineering. Deep inside lies the samophlange, a core component that has baffled engineers across the region. With a firm tug, you free the device from its housing and carry it back to the goblin who began the recovery effort.

sections.title: Fragile Innovations
sections.body: Back in Ratchet, Sputtervalve takes the curious device and plans to send it to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine for study. Goblin curiosity gets the better of him. When he sets the samophlange down for a closer look, its delicate mechanism shatters on the floor, and he scrambles to save what he can of the research.

faq.answer: Even experienced mechanics cannot make sense of the samophlange's jumble of wires, pipes, and odd trinkets. It is the key component inside the Venture Company's control console, though neither Sputtervalve nor the scavengers understand how it works.

faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve want the samophlange?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve plans to send the component to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. Goblin inventors there study and reverse-engineer rival designs, if the device survives inspection.

faq.q: What happens when you hand the samophlange over?
aliases: what does sputtervalve do with it
faq.answer: Sputtervalve plans to send the samophlange to the Tinkers' Union in Undermine, but first he wants to inspect it himself.

faq.q: Who built the control console housing the device?
faq.answer: The Venture Company built the console and samophlange at its Sludge Fen operation in the northern Barrens. Its technological experiments are notorious for slapdash work and pollution.

faq.q: Where does Sputtervalve send you after this?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve sends you to his associate Wenikee Boltbucket, another engineer in the Barrens.
Sputtervalve works on the docks and in the workshops of Ratchet, the port town on the Barrens' eastern coast.

angles.text: For an engineer, the samophlange is a Venture Company machine packed with dense wiring, tubing, and unfamiliar parts that invite careful study.
As a Horde adventurer, you deal with volatile Venture Company scrap in Ratchet's goblin ports, where neutral goblin enterprise can bring explosive incompetence.
